# Paper 11: InstructGPT (2022)

## Study approach
The SFT → reward model → PPO-ptx pipeline. Bradley–Terry loss $-\log\sigma(r(x, y_w) - r(x, y_l))$; the per-token KL penalty $\beta \log(\pi_{RL}/\pi_{SFT})$ as the anti-reward-hacking term.

## Interview hooks
**Rapid-fire:** why SFT masks loss on prompt tokens; a 1.3B aligned model is preferred over 175B unaligned.

## Break-it experiments
1. **AGENT** — Build the toy RLHF loop (GPT-2 policy, DistilBERT sentiment reward, TRL).
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_build_the_toy_rlhf_loop_gpt_2_po.ipynb`
2. **HAND** — Set β = 0 and watch the policy degenerate into "excellent! best! 10/10!" — Goodhart's law live.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_set_0_and_watch_the_policy_degen.ipynb`
